name: llm-auditor
description: IT Auditor quiz analytics with Groq AI: knowledge-gap recommendations, quiz topic suggestions, and a Super Admin -> SQL Agent -> Director acknowledgement workflow. Berjalan di EdgeOne Makers dengan Postgres (Neon) + pgvector.
//: State aplikasi ada di Postgres (Neon) + pgvector — butuh DATABASE_URL. Fitur AI memakai Groq (GROQ_API_KEY); embedding RAG memakai Gemini gemini-embedding-001 (GEMINI_API_KEY). API produksi dijalankan sebagai EdgeOne Makers Agent Functions di agents/ (lihat edgeone.json). Skrip scripts/migrate_sqlite_to_pg.js memakai node:sqlite dan hanya jalan di Node >= 22.5 (lokal).
